accessibility.description:
M4A: resolved accessibility surface (UI scale applied, high-contrast
palette active, captions visible, focusable nodes in z-order).

actors.description: M1: typed projection of every actor in the world. Empty in M0 scenarios.

banners.description:
M4A: HUD banner queue (status/chassis/mission events that should be
surfaced as a top-priority banner). FIFO; HUD draws the most recent N.

breaches.description: M1.5: breach strips in the scenario. Empty for sandbox scenarios.

captions.description:
M4A: captions queue (audio-bound events surfaced as text when
`Settings.captions == true`). Drained in FIFO order; HUD draws last N.

cells.description:
projection (pressure + temperature + gas composition). Empty for
scenarios that don't declare `atmosphere_cells` in the manifest.

controls_capture.description:
cf-ui renders the CAPTURED zone and cf-app suppresses keyboard/mouse
dispatch.

enemies.description: M1.5: reactive guards and their last-tick view. Empty for sandbox scenarios.

gravity_vectors.description:
scenario-base gravity plus stacked overrides as observed at the
actor's position this tick. Empty for scenarios with no actors.

mission.description: M1.5: mission state machine projection. `None` for sandbox scenarios.

player_actor_id.description: Convenience pointer to the player actor in `actors` by id, if any.

reactors.description: M2.5: reactor world projection. Empty for scenarios with no reactors.

ropes.description:
grapple rope + zip-line cable currently in the world. Pulled from
`EngineMutable::m14j_ropes`; consumers read endpoints + tautness.

terrain.description:
M2: chunked terrain summary (per-material counts + carve / refusal /
dirty-chunk counters). `None` when the scenario has no chunked terrain.

tool_validity.description: M4A: tool-validity projection for the HUD TOOL line + AI agents.

trench_segment_at_pos.description:
segment at a queried tile position. `None` when no segment has
been queried OR the queried tile is open ground. Populated on
demand by `observe.trench_segment_at_pos` callers; the standard
observe stream leaves this empty so the frame stays cheap.

ziplines.description:
`ropes` that are deployed zip-line cables (canonical high/low ends
+ active rider count).

AccessibilityView.description:
M4A accessibility surface contract. `Settings` already lives on the wire
via `observe.settings`; the resolved view in the observe frame says how
the HUD has applied each flag at this tick (so consumers can verify a
200%-scale render or high-contrast palette without a screenshot).

focus_cycle.description:
M4A: monotonic counter incremented every time focus advances. Lets
cfctl + cf-e2e detect "focus has cycled at least once" without a
time-based assertion.

focusable_nodes.description:
Stable accessibility ids of every focusable HUD node, in z-order. Used
by `cfctl ui` and `cf-e2e --verify-focus` to prove the HUD has a
keyboard-focusable surface beyond color cues.

focused_node.description:
M4A: id of the currently-focused HUD node (`Some(<id>)` after the
player presses Tab / Shift+Tab / Arrow). `None` when focus is cleared
(default at scenario load + after Escape). Drives the visible focus
ring in cf-ui + the cf-e2e verify path.

hold_threshold_ms.description: M4A: ACC-A-05 hold threshold in milliseconds.

key_bindings.description:
M4A: ACC-A-05 active key bindings (action → KeyCode name). When
`key_remap_enabled` is true, cf-app's keyboard layer consults this
table; when false, defaults apply. Surface is observable so cfctl
can verify the table round-trip without reading the raw Settings.

ActorView.description:
Public projection of one actor for the observe envelope. Mirrors
`cf_actor::ActorObservation` with extra fields (rifle ammo / cooldown / reload
state) the engine wires through.

body_silhouette.description:
M4A: per-zone body silhouette projection (head/torso/arms/legs hp%).
`placeholder=true` for legacy actors without a chassis.

chassis.description: pilot state, eject window). `None` for legacy actors without a chassis.

cover_state.description:
trench segment variant) per VAL-M9B-CFCTL-003 + VAL-M9B-COVERMATRIX-001.
One of `Exposed | Partial | Full`. Defaults to `Exposed` for actors
on open ground (no trench segment under foot).

inventory.description:
slot order (4 entries for M1; "empty" for unset slots). Mirrors
`cf_actor::ActorObservation.inventory` so consumers reading
`observe.frame.actors[]` see the same payload as `observe.actor`.

module_strip.description:
M4A: chassis module strip projection. **M5**: `placeholder=false` when
sourced from a real chassis; `placeholder=true` for the M4A flat-rifle
derivation.

stance.description:
M4A: derived stance label (idle/walking/running/airborne/downed/dead/...).
`cfctl observe` consumers + AI agents read this without a screenshot.

oneOf.description: Snaps reticle slightly toward target; -15% damage.

AtmosphericCellView.description:
Authored by the scenario manifest and mutated by the M14B
stratification kernel each step.

CaptionMode.description: as captions in the HUD strip.

oneOf.description: Critical + warning (default when captions are on).

CaptionView.description:
M4A captions queue entry. When `Settings.captions == true`, audio-bound
events surface as caption rows. Until cf-audio lands at BP6+ the captions
queue carries event-derived placeholders so the contract is testable from
M4A onward (DR-012 ACC-A floor closure).

bleed_rate_per_sec.description: for the actor. Drives the HUD bleeding indicator.

limb_states.description:
chassis zone with the current [`cf_physics::ZoneState`] label, plus
the bleed_rate per-second derived from the zone's state.

ColorCueMode.description:
Accessibility extras — Default / ColorblindSafe / Protanopia /
Deuteranopia / Tritanopia / MonochromeTest.

oneOf.description: Colorblind-safe palette (yellow + blue replacing red + green).

Speech bubbles for chatter + onomatopoeia on impacts + comic-panel
boss intros + comic death recap available behind toggle.

Default — speech bubbles for storyteller events only; no
onomatopoeia stamps; comic death recap available behind toggle.

Disabled — no comic framing renders anywhere; chatter is plain
captions; death recap is M10 timeline only.

ContrastMode.description:
`high_contrast: bool` with a tri-state enum (Standard / HighContrastDark /
HighContrastLight) per spec § Settings tree.

oneOf.description: High-contrast dark — pure white text on solid black.
High-contrast light — pure black text on solid white.

intent_label.description:
tactic ("ALERT: heard_shot", "ENGAGED", "RELOADING", "STUCK:
blocked"). cf-ui surfaces this above the guard sprite when
`Settings.ai_debug == true`.

position.description:
world so the `--ai-debug` floating intent label can anchor at the
sprite. Optional (None when the actor world isn't loaded).

GameSpeedAssist.description: Camera + game feel — Off / Slowdown75 / Slowdown25 / FullPause.

oneOf.description: Toggle on/off — press once to enable, again to disable.
Press-to-cycle — each press advances through a state ring.

HudBannerView.description:
M4A HUD banner queue entry. Surfaced from chassis/status/mission events so
HUD + `cfctl observe` consumers see the same priority-ordered banner stack.
The text-only banner is the M4A floor; M4B layers comic-noir styling on
top without changing the queue contract.

accessibility_id.description:
Stable accessibility id surfaced for `cfctl ui` (M4A surface; M4B+
extends to comic-noir card nodes).

expires_at_tick.description: Tick the banner expires at (no expiration when `None`).

label.description:
Player-facing banner text (English at M4A; Tier-A localization keys at
the next milestone-enhancement pass).

raised_at_tick.description: Tick the banner was raised at; used for FIFO drain priority + replay.

severity.description:
Severity: `critical` (red-equivalent), `warning` (amber-equivalent),
`info` (neutral). Severity is text + icon, never color-only — HUD MUST
render the severity word + icon glyph alongside the label.

oneOf.description: Keyboard only — no mouse / no controller.
Custom — player has rebound mixed inputs.

MissionView.description: M1.5 mission projection (re-exposed via JsonSchema-friendly types).

PersonalPowerConfig.description:
M17 § "Settings + configuration surface" — per-origin personal-power +
oxygen + robot-thermal toggles. PvE survival enables these; some PvP modes
disable them.

starter_race_recommendations_per_world.description: Per-world starter-race recommendations (world id → origin id).

ReactorView.description:
M2.5 reactor projection. Drives the HUD reactor-hp bar + the cfctl
`inspect reactor <id>` lookup.

is_zipline.description:
`true` if this rope is tagged as a zip-line cable (consult
`ziplines[]` for the canonical orientation).

ai_debug.description:
every reactive guard ("ALERT: heard_shot", "ENGAGED", "RELOADING").
Toggled via `--ai-debug` CLI flag on cf-app and `act.settings.set
{ ai_debug: true }` through cfctl.

ai_difficulty.description:
matching `cf-ai::DifficultyPreset` to every `ReactiveGuard` whenever
this changes.

caption_mode.description: Expanded). Filters which events surface as captions.

cinematic_captions_enabled.description:
ribbon. Defaults to `captions` (M11 mode) but exposed as a
separate flag so cfctl tests can toggle the cinematic surface
independently of the gameplay caption strip. Per spec § "the
M12A `caption_visible` predicate gates the subtitle ribbon".

comic_death_recap.description:
cause chain. When `false` (default), the M10 replay viewer +
cause-chain walker is used. Gated by `comic_style_overlay != Off`.

comic_style_overlay.description:
speech bubbles, onomatopoeia stamps, comic-panel boss intros, and
the comic death-recap availability. Default is `Subtle` per spec
§ Comic-style framing — opt-in juice, not core identity.

debug_enabled.description:
7 cf-debug overlays only render when `debug_enabled = true`. Dev
builds bypass the gate.

debug_overlays.description:
per `cf_debug::DebugOverlay::as_str`). Mirrors the cf-debug
`DebugOverlayState` so cfctl `observe.debug.overlays` round-trips.

gravity.description:
`cf-physics` (units / s²; negative pulls toward the floor). Default
`-980.0`.

hold_threshold_ms.description:
M4A: hold threshold in milliseconds. Default 250 ms; clamped to
`[50..2000]` by `apply_settings_patch`.

hold_to_confirm.description:
M4A: hold-to-press alternative for tap-to-press actions (ACC-A-05).
When `true`, edge-triggered actions (jump / fire / reload / dig /
reset / select_slot_*) require holding the key/button for
`hold_threshold_ms` before firing instead of triggering on the press
edge. Default: off (tap semantics). cf-app's `ingest_player_input`
honors this through the `HoldTracker` resource; cfctl-driven
dispatches bypass the hold gate (control-plane is already explicit
press/release semantics).

key_bindings.description:
M4A: per-action key binding overrides. Action names are limited to
[`SUPPORTED_KEY_BINDING_ACTIONS`]; KeyCode names are limited to
[`SUPPORTED_KEY_CODE_NAMES`]. Empty by default; `act.settings.set`
replaces the table only after validation so unsupported remaps reject
at the control boundary instead of silently falling back in cf-app.

key_remap_enabled.description:
M4A: when `true`, cf-app's keyboard layer reads its action bindings
from `key_bindings` instead of the built-in defaults. When `false`,
the built-in defaults apply (Space=jump, Enter|J=fire, R=reload,
G=dig, L=reset, 1..4=select_slot_0..3). The remap UI editor lands
at M8; M4A ships the cfctl-settable surface so the contract is
behavior-testable today.

personal_power.description: M17 § per-origin personal-power + oxygen + robot-thermal config.

reduce_camera_shake_pct.description:
multiplied by `(1.0 - reduce_camera_shake_pct)`. 0.0 = full shake,
1.0 = no shake. Clamped to `[0, 1]` by `apply_settings_patch`.

reduced_g_force_blackout.description:
M17 § "G-Force HUD blackout" accessibility — caps the concussion
vignette/blackout at the Moderate band (no Severe tunneling / KO
blackout) for photosensitive / motion-sensitive players. Default off.

screen_shake_scale.description:
0.0 = no shake). Multiplicative on camera punch + recoil shake.
Replaces the inverse-sense `reduce_camera_shake_pct`; the legacy
field is preserved for back-compat (mirror updated whenever this
changes via `apply_settings_patch`).

speedrun_mode.description: markers; mission resolves immediately on objectives).

storyteller.description:
(`cassandra_classic` | `phoebe_chillax` | `randy_random` |
`ironman` | `sandbox`). Forward-compat with M25's director-driven
storyteller selection. cf-shell + cfctl set this via
`act.settings.set`; cf-cinematic reads it at every kernel engage
per spec § "The cinematic player reads the active storyteller
from M25 director state and applies its profile globally."

text_scale.description: distinct field per spec § Settings menu Accessibility tab).

tick_rate_hz.description:
`tick_rate_hz` so cfctl `observe.settings` round-trips a single
authoritative value. Defaults to 60.

walk_threshold.description: actor counts as "slow enough" to keep building sharp aim. Default 1.5.

TerrainView.description:
M2 chunked terrain projection. Per-material pixel counts let cfctl + AI
hooks query "how much air do we have left?" without pulling the full
snapshot. Carve / refusal / dirty counters expose perf health.

M2 extension: `current_overlay_mode`, `total_carve_events`, and
`total_debris_spawned` surface the 5-mode overlay state + cumulative
debris counter for `observe.terrain` + the material legend HUD.

chunk_count.description:
`allocated_chunk_count`. Same value, different field name so
consumers can read either.

material_distribution.description:
{id: pixel_count}` keyed by material id (u8). Same data as
`material_counts` but with id keys instead of name keys.

ToolValidityView.description:
M4A tool-validity projection. Mirrors the `terrain.tool_refused` reason
code together with the most-recent successful `terrain.terrain_carved`
tick. Consumed by the HUD `TOOL` line and AI agents that want a one-shot
"is this tile diggable right now?" answer without scanning the event log.

TrenchSegmentView.description:
returned by `observe.trench_segment_at_pos`. The shape mirrors
`cf_trench::TrenchSegment` so cfctl callers get a stable JSON view.

embedded_modules.description:
Ids of embedded modules (`duckboard`, `fire_step`, etc.) — order
preserved from the authoring RON.

variant.description:
One of the six declared variants
(`shallow_scrape | standard | deep | communication | fire_step | parapet_raised`).

UiDensity.description:
Compact / Comfortable / Spacious. M11 added `Comfortable` as the canonical
default-density name (was `Normal` under M8 — accepted as an alias).

oneOf.description: Comfortable — default density (M11 canonical name; alias `normal`).
